summary: SCFC steel tower on Paris Mountain, erected 1937-38 with CCC labour; sold at a state surplus auction in December 2018. No source we read says whether it still stands.

facts.design: Steel lookout tower, about 80 feet tall
facts.status_note: Sold at a December 2018 state surplus auction; no source we read says whether the steel still stands or where it went.

access.note: Forest Lookouts describes it as a shuttered lookout tower when it went to auction in 2018; no source we read says it is open to visitors.

visit.trail_note: SC Trails lists a Fire Tower Trail in Paris Mountain State Park; no source says the tower itself is open.

events.note: Seven new steel towers erected in the 1937-38 fiscal year, Paris Mountain among them; a February 20, 1938 item describes it still under construction, 80 feet high, built by CCC enrollees.
1938-39 commission report: dwelling, barn, smokehouse, chicken house and latrine built at six tower sites, Paris Mountain among them.
Sold at a state surplus auction in December 2018; the winning bidder had to load and remove it.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1936-37 state guide, quoted by Forest Lookouts, already places a fire tower at the top of the mountain, while the 1937-38 report and a February 1938 newspaper item describe the steel tower being erected then. The sources do not say whether an earlier structure stood there.
Forest Lookouts says the buyers had about seven days to remove the tower; Fox News says the buyer had 10 days. Neither explains the difference.
Fox News reports the high bid as $525 by early Saturday; Forest Lookouts reports $3,300 paid. Neither source explains the difference.
Fox News calls the steel a 72-year-old structure. A 1938 build would make it about 80 years old in 2018.

notes_for_editor: Brief had status and access unknown; this adds a 1937-38 build and a December 2018 surplus sale. The Charlotte Observer article timed out and the Post and Courier article returned HTTP 429, so the sale is documented through Fox News and WYFF only. The NRHP phrase 'the old fire tower site' does not clearly say the tower stood in 1998. A YouTube short titled 'Former firetower site at Paris Mountain State Park, SC' gave only its title, so it is not cited. A 2018 FFLA chapter report surfaced in search about a Greenville-area tower moved to Fairfield County; it does not name Paris Mountain, so it is not used.
